assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the REVIEWED discovery reference kss12-company-and-curiosity: the active_provisional V2 KSS12 reading, its preserved observations and its bounded LN05/LN09 comparisons. Native story 小松澪と謎多き女 is described at 01p1-73; comparison ranges are LN05 item/xhtml/p-006.xhtml p245-300 and item/xhtml/p-008.xhtml p1-75, LN09 item/xhtml/p-012.xhtml p64-115, as represented in that artifact. Other series artifacts inform method and scope only. No independent primary-media inspection, full-novel Mio coverage, web/V1 evidence, or cross-continuity aggregation is claimed.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: KSS12 university lecture-end encounter facing summer break, through Mio's deferred inquiry and unaccepted next-mixer request (MIO-KSS12-DEFERRED-INQUIRY-EXIT in the evidence, not a new registry state identity). Exact day/year/college year and same-event novel placement are unknown. LN05 referral and LN09 later roommate-call contexts remain separate; later knowledge is not backdated.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: KSS-12-O002/O003, 01p9-35/42-59/69-73: Mio wants Hazuki's company and an explanation of refusals, and recognizes that acceptance would also provoke curiosity. This supports local, partly self-reported motives; it does not establish stable priorities across settings. LN05 referral context complicates a curiosity-only account.

KSS-12-O005 and CLM-KSS-12-003.v1 preserve LN05 practical referral, the summer-facing supplement, and LN09 roommate-call knowledge as separate clocks. Mio's reported change in invitation acceptance is not a measured trajectory. Exact placement of KSS12 and a continuous developmental policy remain unestablished.

KSS-12-O002/O003, 01p17-35/53-73: invitations, complaint, familiar teasing and demands are source-located, with private narration kept separate. The reading preserves the atashi/watashi variation and Hazuki address. These are local lexical/pragmatic observations, not a stable generative register or acoustic model.

KSS-12-O002/O003, 01p1-40/61-73: a lecture-end invitation becomes shopping negotiation and renewed inquiry; Mio eventually defers the inquiry but requests compensation. This constrains the depicted encounter. It does not establish frequency, future attendance, or ordinary routines outside this interaction.

KSS-12-O002/O003, 01p27-42/53-73, and O005: Mio treats her friendship with Hazuki as permitting familiar complaint; reassurance coexists with maintained refusal. LN05 contact-sharing permission is action-specific. One principal interlocutor and Mio's own closeness judgment do not establish a policy for other relationships.

KSS-12-O002/O003, 01p9-15/33-35/42-59/69-73: sustained Mio focalization gives represented desire, frustration, fascination and self-complicating curiosity. Her explanation remains a self-report, not proof of every cause, a diagnosis, or access to Sendai's private reasons. It is a local interior account rather than an integrated psychological reconstruction.

KSS-12-O002/O003, 01p17-40/53-73: refusal produces substitution, complaint, an explicit arm grip, further inquiry and eventual deferral of that inquiry. Reassurance does not turn refusal into assent; deferral does not erase pressure. This is a specific disagreement, not a general escalation, repair or high-stakes conflict model.

The reviewed material distinguishes permission, refusal and pressure, but no reconstruction of Mio's ethical reasoning or trade-off procedure has been established. Observed boundary behavior and the analyst's ethical distinctions are not automatically Mio's own explicit deliberation.

KSS-12-O002/O003, 01p27-35/57-59/73: familiar teasing and a smiling compensation request coexist with complaint and self-reflection. The playful reading is supported locally, while pressure and an unaccepted request remain. No broader comic repertoire or humor toward unfamiliar people is established.

KSS-12-O002/O003/O004/O005 document a complete native supplemental story, bounded LN05/LN09 comparison, and qualified PDF correspondence. Completeness of this story is not completeness of Mio's character evidence across the novels or witnesses. The assessment inspects repository analysis, not the primary-source package independently.

CLM-KSS-12-001.v1 through -003.v1: explicit self-questioning counters a globally unreflective Mio; the LN05 permission request counters an always-disregards-permission rule; maintained refusals counter invitation-equals-assent; the arm grip and renewed demands counter an unqualified harmless-play reading. These are substantial distributed countercases within the curated analysis, not a tested general abstention model.

KSS-12-O002/O003/O005: lecture-end setting, approaching summer, and a proposed Sunday outing constrain the local episode. LN05 and LN09 retain separate event/disclosure clocks; later roommate knowledge cannot be backdated. Exact day, year, college year and identity with a novel event are not established.

scenario_readiness.note: Local source utterances and pragmatics are documented, but no procedure for generating new Mio dialogue with preserved knowledge and register has been established. Readiness remains unassessed; fluent imitation would not establish it.

No counterfactual or materially novel scenario assessment has been established for a fixed Mio chronology, interlocutor relationship and setting. The unresolved KSS12 placement must not be filled by importing later knowledge. No cross-scenario scope or transfer permission is asserted.

The lecture-end exchange supports bounded canon interpretation. A transferable response policy for a new ordinary social encounter has not been established, even for Hazuki. This is an evidence gap in readiness, not demonstrated inability to behave ordinarily.
No scenario assessment of Mio's ethical deliberation has been established. Local consent-related actions do not supply an ethical decision procedure.

No romantic-response or broader relationship-scenario readiness has been established. Mio's fascination, boyfriend hypothesis and wish for company do not establish her romantic motive; friendship evidence does not resolve an untested scenario.
A practical tutoring referral and permission to share contact information do not establish Mio's professional role, competence or response policy. Professional-scenario readiness remains unassessed.

known_limits.statement: Mio's boyfriend hypothesis is presented as her inference, while Sendai states a report priority. KSS12 does not name Miyagi. O005 separates LN09 roommate-name knowledge and Sendai's private explanations from the current scene; those later/private propositions cannot be supplied to current Mio as facts.

The reading affirmatively contrasts maintained refusals, an explicit arm grip and renewed demands with LN05's contact-sharing permission exchange. No global always-violates-boundaries or universally-harmless-play rule follows; permission and refusal have their own act and time scopes.

01p59 and p69-73 give Mio self-questioning and deferred inquiry alongside a renewed compensation request. Reflection does not establish that all pressure ended or that Sendai accepted the proposed mixer.

Exact KSS12 day/year/college year and its identity with a novel event are unestablished. Grip assent, duration, release and injury, actual departure, report completion and future mixer attendance are not established in this evidence set; their absence is not proof of the opposite.

The sole curated artifact supplies one local focalized scene and bounded comparisons, not a comprehensive Mio corpus or an independently tested response model. New-interlocutor, counterfactual, ethical, romantic, professional and acoustic capability remain unestablished. This evaluator has not independently inspected the original source package.
